title: Menstrual Cycle & Ovulation Tracker
subtitle: Monitor your cycle regularity, phases, and ovulation windows with clinical accuracy

phaseDescriptions.period: Menstruation — Resting phase, lower estrogen and progesterone levels.
phaseDescriptions.follicular: Follicular — Follicle maturation phase; rising estrogen supports energy.
phaseDescriptions.ovulation: Ovulatory Window — Peak estrogen and LH surge; fertile window.
phaseDescriptions.luteal: Luteal Phase — Rising progesterone; monitor for PMS or metabolic sensitivity.
phaseDescriptions.overdue: Overdue Cycle — Cycle has extended beyond the expected length; hormone levels or cycle variation may be present.

cycleStoryDesc: Log your first period to begin understanding your patterns, biological phases, and longitudinal rhythms.
cycleEncryptedNotice: Your cycle records are privately encrypted with Row Level Security (RLS).
responsibleBoundaryDesc: BioPulse AI cycle projections, estimated phases, and fertile windows are calculated from your self-reported dates and historical rhythm. They are informational estimations and do not constitute diagnostic ovulation detection or medical birth control.
periodOverdueAlert: Your period is currently {{count}} days past the expected date ({{expectedDate}}). Delayed cycles may occur due to hormonal variability, stress, or PCOS.
irregularUncertainNotice: Your recorded cycle lengths vary. Calendar-based fertile windows and ovulation days are estimates and cannot confirm actual ovulation.
insufficientHistoryNotice: At least 2 recorded period start dates are needed to calculate historical cycle lengths. Displaying baseline estimates.

cycleLengthSource.default: Standard baseline estimate (no completed cycles yet)

fertilityDisclaimer: Calendar calculations are estimates and must not be used as contraception or medical proof of ovulation.
spottingNotice: Spotting is light bleeding between periods and is tracked separately from standard menstrual flow.
